robot: Franka Emika Panda on a fixed mount with a two-finger gripper, driven by LIBERO's operational-space controller (end-effector deltas)

frame.suite: LIBERO's world frame (metres, z up; the robot faces +x)
frame.base_text: the robot base frame: at the arm's mount, +X forward across the table, +Y the robot's left, +Z up; its axes are parallel to LIBERO's world axes

arm.note: Panda arm under LIBERO's OSC_POSE controller: it takes end-effector deltas only; absolute pose goals are reached by repeated bounded steps, re-measured after each step. The gripper is open or closed only.

ee_delta.point: the gripper's grip site, between the fingertips (orientation: the hand)
ee_delta.note: execute_trajectory space ee_delta: each row is one 0.05 s control step; dpos (m) and drot (rad, rotation vector) move the hand's target away from the measured hand pose by that much in that step (at most 0.05 m and 0.5 rad a step); the hand covers only part of it within the step, so a steady motion needs a run of rows.

notes: The arm takes end-effector deltas only (LIBERO's operational-space controller, 20 Hz): move_robot reaches a hand pose to within about 1 cm and 0.05 rad by repeated measured steps; execute_trajectory space ee_delta sends per-step deltas. The gripper is open or closed (gripper >= 0.5 closes); it takes about 0.4 s to close or open, so give it a gripper-only goal before moving off with a grasped object. The reported gripper value is the last command; the finger positions (finger_left, finger_right, m) are in proprio_now. Native action ee_delta: [dx, dy, dz, drx, dry, drz, grip], each in [-1, 1], one row per 0.05 s step: 1.0 = 0.05 m / 0.5 rad of hand-target motion in the world frame (whose axes are the base frame's), grip +1 closes, -1 opens. The cameras' intrinsics and poses at the start (cam2world_gl, OpenGL axes, world frame) are in describe_robot's spec_file; each action's result carries the current ones (cameras_now; the wrist camera moves with the hand).
